answer.explanation: Every CompressionFunction invocation in the window fails at S3.put_object with NoSuchBucket, which means the target bucket named by OUTPUT_BUCKET does not exist. The other functions complete normally, and the error is not an AccessDenied, so this is not an IAM permission problem. The most likely cause is that the live OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable points to a bucket name that was never created or was mistyped. No tool results were available, so I could not confirm the live value or check the IaC template, which limits confidence.
